summary: Trex Company Inc. filed an 8-K on July 13, 2026, announcing a National Distribution Agreement with U.S. Lumber Group and termination of its relationship with Boise Cascade effective August 12, 2026. The agreement appoints USL as exclusive national distributor of Trex Products in the U.S. and Canada starting January 1, 2027, with a dual-distribution model to be implemented by January 2029. No financial terms, prices, or premiums are disclosed; this is a routine commercial distribution contract, not a special situation. No risk-arb angle, as no M&A or corporate event is present.
